body:
WHAT
Edit replaces one exact string in a file with another. The file must have been Read this session and not changed on disk since (the FileState store tracks mtime and size). old_string must appear exactly once unless replace_all is set; zero matches and multiple matches produce different error messages, and the zero-match message tells the caller not to include the Read line-number prefix. Identical old/new is refused. On success it emits a file_edited event with a unified diff.

WHY
Without the freshness check an edit could clobber changes the model never saw; without the uniqueness check a short snippet could silently change the wrong place.

WHERE
engine/tools/src/edit.ts — editTool (permissionClass 'mutate', isFileEdit:true), execute(): isAbsolute check, identical-string check, ctx.session.fileState.checkFresh(path), countOccurrences(), the 0 and >1 branches, split/join for replace_all, writeFileSync, fileState.recordRead(), emit file_edited with unifiedDiff() from engine/tools/src/util/diff.ts. Freshness logic: engine/core/src/runtime/fileState.ts — FileState.checkFresh()/recordRead().

TEST CHECKLIST
1. In a temp dir write 'a\nb\n'; call Edit without a prior fileState.recordRead; assert isError:true and content contains 'has not been read in this session'.
2. recordRead the file, then append to it on disk (change mtime/size) and call Edit; assert isError:true with 'modified on disk since it was last read'.
3. recordRead a file containing 'foo' twice; Edit { old_string:'foo', new_string:'bar' } returns isError with 'matches 2 places'; Edit with old_string 'zzz' returns isError with 'not found' and 'line-number prefix'; the file is unchanged in both cases.
4. Edit { old_string:'x', new_string:'x' } returns isError 'identical'; Edit with a relative file_path returns isError 'must be absolute'.
5. recordRead a file with 'foo' twice; Edit with replace_all:true replaces both, content says 'replaced 2 occurrences', a file_edited event with a diff was emitted, and a second Edit right after succeeds (recordRead refreshed the stamp).
